Name: Pure Vanilla Cookie FS
Author: BlueJestar
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/GU8keb8.png[/img]﻿
﻿Pure Vanilla Cookie is a fictional character from the popular mobile game Cookie Run: Kingdom.[/center]

This mod allows you to equip custom clothing from the Fashion Sense mirror that will make your player look like Pure Vanilla Cookie! This mod does not affect any actual gameplay, only the appearance. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/suHzq2E.png[/img]

STEP 1) Click "Manual" and then "Slow Download"
STEP 2) Once downloaded, extract the file
Step 3) Move the extracted file into Stardew Valley/Mods

[img]https://i.imgur.com/M7KlO44.png[/img]

Compatible with...
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later;
[*]Linux, macOS, and Windows;
[*]single-player and multiplayer
[*]No known mod conflicts
[/list]
